scope: Corollary 7.9 (Quality through the recursion) of the manuscript “Almost-Linear-Time Maximum-Cardinality Matching in General Graphs” (preprints/Almost-Linear-Time-Maximum-Cardinality-Matching-in-Sparse-General-Graphs-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 120 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3cce6ec72ecade69), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 62. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume the path assignments and public forest lifting of Section 8. The backend at level i returns a certified score at least 1 2 b−2(d−i) OPTi . (7.24) At the outer level this is at least M−10/a OPT.
